logMd:
### Round 1 - Track T3 (Claude Code plugin marketplaces)

**Date:** 2026-08-26. **Method:** live web only; every candidate repo opened this session.

**Platforms searched:** anthropics/claude-plugins-official (marketplace.json, ~300 plugins), anthropics/claude-plugins-community (marketplace.json, 2282 plugins, downloaded and regex-mined locally), anthropics/claude-plugins-public, anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins, claudemarketplaces.com (marketplace directory + design-ui category, 80 rows), claudedirectory.org (design topic), claude-plugins.dev, plus 6 WebSearch query variations. grep.app API was 429-rate-limited on both attempts (listed inaccessible). gh CLI not used per instructions.

**Key queries:** see `queries` array - 14 recorded query actions; the single highest-yield step was downloading the community marketplace.json (1.5MB) and grepping it for design/ux/a11y/research keywords (88 hits).

**URLs opened:** ~40 (see `urlsOpened`). All 30 recorded candidates were opened and verified this session; one official path guess (knowledge-work-plugins/plugins/design) 404'd and was corrected to /design.

**Headline finds:**
- **anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins `design` plugin** (Apache-2.0, 23.7k stars): 6 skills - design-critique, design-system-management, ux-writing, accessibility-review, user-research, design-handoff. The closest existing analog to this registry.
- **Mega-star community skills** discovered via marketplace directories: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill (121k), nexu-io/open-design (92k, itself a hybrid design-skill marketplace), pbakaus/impeccable (63k, design-QA with 59 deterministic detectors), google-labs-code/stitch-skills (8.2k), Dammyjay93/interface-design (5.6k).
- **Full-cycle designer collections:** Owl-Listener/designer-skills (107 skills, 9 plugins), wondelai/skills (10 UX book-framework skills), imsaif/design-with-claude (48 specialists + audit CLI).
- **Accessibility:** AccessLint/skills (5-skill WCAG 2.2 workflow with real tooling), Community-Access/accessibility-agents (11 specialists, community-built), Shopify liquid-theme-a11y, deepakkamboj marketplace.
- **Research/discovery/analytics:** cookiy user-research (1.5k stars), gambit, prepkit-product, ux-superpowers, tarunccet/pm-skills, amplitude plugin (25+ analytics skills).
- **Design systems:** murphytrueman/design-system-ops (DTCG token compliance, drift detection), hamen/material-3-skill, tekgnosis-net/apple-design-marketplace.

**Rejections:** junk community-marketplace entries (figma-test 'asdfaf', james 'UI DESIGN'), auto-generated barnburner121 generated-plugins dump, prompt-style agent files in ananddtyagi marketplace, AEC architecture suite, Russian-only UX-writing plugin, deepmiro (PR simulation).

**Could not verify/access:** grep.app (429 twice); star counts for claude-plugins-public, canva-skills, miro-ai not shown on fetched pages; deepakkamboj skill-file format ambiguous (marked in notes); Canva/Adobe individual SKILL.md contents one hop short of full verification.

**New queries generated from findings (for round 2):** mine wilwaldon/Claude-Code-Frontend-Design-Toolkit; sweep github topics claude-code-marketplace / claude-design / claude-code-plugin; open the ~15 unopened repos from claudemarketplaces design-ui rows (wshobson/agents, plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills, leonxlnx/taste-skill, davila7/claude-code-templates, softaworks/agent-toolkit...); open anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins product-management skills; verify seedflip, design-drift, claude2figma, figma-suite, blueprint-trigger, mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills, aiocean aio-design-system, anti-slop-ui; check masuP9/airowe/mgifford a11y skills; retry grep.app for third-party marketplace.json files not in the community registry.

**Saturation:** The two Anthropic marketplaces are effectively exhausted (official fully enumerated; community regex-mined - only non-keyword-matching design plugins could hide). Marketplace *directories* (claudemarketplaces, claudedirectory) are mined but their long tails are not. The unexhausted axis is individual-repo verification of the ~25 named-but-unopened leads and GitHub topic sweeps for marketplaces outside the community registry.
